what_not_to_do: Do not catch or handle the snake. Do not attempt to cut the bite, suck venom or apply a tourniquet.
snakebite_first_aid: Immediately move away from the snake. Remove tight items from around the bitten area. Keep the person calm and immobilize the person and affected limb. Transport the person to a health facility as soon as possible. Avoid tourniquets, cutting or incising the bite, sucking venom, herbal remedies and other traditional treatments. Monitor airway and breathing and provide appropriate emergency care.
